Fall Colors & Cider: The Ultimate Guide to Des Moines' Apple Orchards & Pumpkin Patches 2024

As autumn paints Central Iowa in brilliant hues of red and gold, Des Moines residents and visitors alike flock to the area's beloved apple orchards and pumpkin patches. Whether you're craving fresh-pressed cider, searching for the perfect jack-o'-lantern, or planning a festive family outing, this comprehensive guide will help you discover the best fall destinations in the Des Moines metro area.

Must-Visit Apple Orchards Near Des Moines

Center Grove Orchard - Maxwell

Just 30 minutes northeast of downtown Des Moines, Center Grove Orchard offers more than just apple picking. Their 25-acre fall playground features:

  • 20+ apple varieties
  • Famous apple cider donuts
  • Corn maze and hayrack rides
  • Farm-to-table café
  • Children's activities and petting zoo

Wilson's Orchard & Farm - Iowa City

Worth the drive from Des Moines, Wilson's combines traditional orchard experiences with modern amenities:

  • Hard cider taproom
  • Smokehouse restaurant
  • 120 acres of scenic hiking trails
  • U-pick apples and pumpkins

Top Pumpkin Patches in the Des Moines Metro

Howell's Pumpkin Patch - Cumming

Just minutes from West Des Moines, this family-favorite destination features:

  • 10-acre pumpkin patch
  • Giant corn maze
  • Weekend fall festival activities
  • Fresh kettle corn and local treats

Pierce's Pumpkin Patch - Grimes

A perfect afternoon destination for families in the northwestern suburbs, offering:

  • Tractor-drawn hay rides
  • Farm animal encounters
  • Instagram-worthy photo opportunities
  • Fresh-baked pies and treats

Local Tips for the Perfect Fall Outing

Make the most of your autumn adventure with these insider suggestions:

  • Visit early in the season (mid-September) for prime apple picking
  • Go on weekdays to avoid crowds
  • Bring cash for some vendors
  • Wear sturdy shoes and dress in layers
  • Check social media for special events and harvest updates

Seasonal Events & Activities

Enhance your fall experience with these complementary activities:

  • Downtown Farmers' Market (through October)
  • Valley Junction Fall Festival
  • Living History Farms' Harvest Festival
  • East Village Fall Crawl
